hero.heading:
Hi, I'm Rutger.

I build things

end to end
hero.subtitle: ICT student building web things with Next.js, TypeScript and a self-hosted Kubernetes pipeline. And Rust firmware for ESP32s, when the web is not enough.

about.label: // who am i
about.statement: I like building things end to end: web apps with Next.js and TypeScript, the self-hosted Kubernetes cluster they run on, and Rust firmware for ESP32 & nRF52 microcontrollers.
about.text: Graduated as a Software Developer at ROC Nijmegen, and in 2026 I started my ICT bachelor's at Fontys University of Applied Sciences in Eindhoven.

work.label: // selected work
work.title: Things I've shipped
work.photoTotal: {photos, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} across {projects} projects

dijker-website.title: Dijker Website
dijker-website.text: Bilingual website for the dijker, a vehicle with a one-of-a-kind spiral belt drive. Built with Next.js and deployed to a VM with Docker Compose and Caddy, with a preview environment for every pull request.

kubernetes-platform.title: Self-hosted Kubernetes Platform
kubernetes-platform.text: The K3s cluster in my homelab that runs my websites. A reusable GitHub Actions workflow deploys every app with OpenTofu: each pull request gets its own preview URL with a TLS certificate, and every merge goes straight to production.

motorized-blinds.title: Motorized Blinds
motorized-blinds.text: Rust firmware that motorizes my blinds: ESP32 modules drive the motors, and a custom nRF52840 remote controls them over radio, all in a 3D-printed case.

real-life-soundboard.title: Real-life Soundboard
real-life-soundboard.text: Nine physical buttons on an ESP32 that trigger sounds on an Android phone over Bluetooth LE. Rust firmware on the ESP32, and a Kotlin app that keeps working in the background.

stack.label: // my stack, as a keyboard

stack.text: Each key is a tool I use. Press one to see where it shows up in my projects and what it pairs with. The modifier keys filter by layer. Keys with a light are daily drivers.

tools.typescript: My main language for anything web. Typed end to end, from components to API routes.

tools.caddy: Reverse proxy and automatic TLS in front of the Dijker website.

tools.helm: Packages the apps that get deployed to my cluster.

tools.opentofu: Infrastructure as code that deploys every app from one reusable workflow.
tools.terraform: Infrastructure as code for deploying this portfolio.
tools.github-actions: CI/CD: a preview URL for every pull request, production on every merge.
tools.rust: Firmware language for my ESP32 and nRF52840 projects.
tools.embassy: Async Rust framework for embedded firmware.

tools.nrf52840: Radio chip inside the custom remote for my blinds.
tools.bluetooth-le: Connects the soundboard buttons to an Android phone.
tools.3d-printing: Custom cases for my hardware projects.
tools.kotlin: The Android app that plays soundboard sounds, even in the background.
